svg.text: Cast plug: 230 mm dia at the tip to 280 at the flange, 240 long; 15

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mm shell, 30 mm tip; flange 450 dia x 45. Open at the top: the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside is a cone 206 dia at the floor to 259 at the top (draft 6 deg).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pattern: printed PLA, flat-back, flange top face down on the board,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plug pointing up; the inside forms its own sand core, so no core

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: box. Add 1.3 % shrink, 3 mm to lap off the flange underside,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 degree draft on the flange rim. Print in 8 segments, glue, seal.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Finish: lap the flange underside flat; plug to printed templates.

svg.text: Bushes: 22 mm holes through the flange at 202 mm each side, steel

svg.text: bushes 22 x 16 x 45 set in retaining compound; 16 mm bore reamed.

svg.text: middle, square to the axes, for the stem's adapter disc.
